meta.category: car wash (multi-bay express + full-service, with membership plans)
assumptions: Single physical site with 4 express-tunnel/conveyor bays plus 2 full-service detail bays (6 bays total) - 'service bays, technician queues' read as a multi-bay express/full-service hybrid, not a single-bay operation.

Revenue is a mix of pay-per-wash retail tickets and monthly unlimited membership subscriptions (the dominant modern car-wash business model), plus a small walk-up B2B/fleet segment (local delivery vans, rental-lot vehicles) - not a formal B2B sales org.
Vehicle types priced in 3 tiers: sedan/coupe, suv-truck, van-oversized (motorcycles/oversized commercial rigs turned away or quoted manually, out of scope).
Full-service/detail bay work (hand wax, interior detailing) is appointment-capable; express tunnel wash is walk-in/queue only.
IoT sensors are installed on the highest-value, highest-downtime-cost equipment (tunnel conveyor motor, water reclaim system, boiler, air compressor, dryer blowers) - not on every hand tool.
The business already has a POS/payment processor and a Google Business Profile; no existing loyalty program to migrate from.
Located in a single US state for this compile (sales tax + labor law scoped to one jurisdiction) - multi-state/franchise expansion would recompile meta.scale and the tax/HR sections.

No formal B2B sales pipeline compiled (see crm.md) - fleet/commercial interest is handled via lightweight lead scoring and a human follow-up task, not a staged deal pipeline, per the 'mostly walk-in business' guidance.

ontology.valueFlow: Customers pay per-visit for a wash package priced by vehicle type, or via a monthly unlimited membership subscription auto-billed to a stored card, with a small fleet/commercial segment billed net-15 on invoice.
ontology.primaryLifecycle: VehicleQueued -> BayAssigned -> WashCycle -> QualityCheck -> Checkout/MembershipVerified -> VehicleExit

entities.name: Customer
entities.description: A car wash guest - pay-per-wash retail customer, member, or fleet/commercial account (isFleetAccount flag), all in one entity since a fleet contact is still an individual who signs up the same way.

entities.name: Vehicle
entities.description: A vehicle on file for a customer; a membership attaches to a specific vehicle (plate-linked) so the tunnel's plate-recognition camera can verify membership automatically.

entities.name: Wash Package
entities.description: A service tier a vehicle can be washed under - the express tunnel line offers the first two tiers, the detail bays offer the top two.

entities.name: Package Pricing
entities.description: Join entity: price of a WashPackage varies by vehicle size, since a van/oversized vehicle costs more in chemical and tunnel time than a sedan.

entities.name: Membership Plan
entities.description: An unlimited-wash monthly subscription tier. This is the dominant revenue driver in modern express car washes, not a side loyalty feature.

entities.name: Membership Subscription
entities.description: A specific customer+vehicle enrolled in a plan, plate-linked for tunnel entry verification.

entities.name: Service Bay
entities.description: A physical wash lane or detail bay. The tunnel is 1 continuous conveyor lane counted as bays 1-4 (positions along the line); detail bays 5-6 are discrete stalls.

entities.name: Wash Order
entities.description: One vehicle's trip through the wash - the primary lifecycle entity. Everything else (queue, IoT downtime cost, membership verification, analytics) hangs off this.

entities.name: Employee
entities.description: HR record for a staff member, distinct from the RBAC role they log in as.

entities.name: Shift
entities.description: A scheduled block of an employee's time, optionally pinned to a bay/lane.

entities.name: Asset
entities.description: Durable wash equipment - distinct from consumable Supply. This is what the IoT/predictive-maintenance layer watches.

entities.name: Maintenance Order
entities.description: A tracked work order for asset service, triggered either by a fixed preventive schedule or by the predictive-maintenance agent reading telemetry drift.

entities.name: Supply Item
entities.description: A consumable used per wash - chemicals and disposables. Distinct from Asset.

entities.name: Warehouse
entities.description: A stock-holding location on site (this is a single-location business, so these are storage rooms, not branches).

entities.name: Stock
entities.description: Item x Warehouse -> quantity on hand.

entities.name: Supplier
entities.description: A chemical/parts vendor.

entities.name: Purchase Order
entities.description: An order to a supplier for chemicals, towels, or equipment parts.

entities.name: Stock Adjustment
entities.description: Shrinkage/write-off record - spillage, breakage, expired reclaim filter media, theft.

entities.name: Invoice
entities.description: A billable document - membership charges, per-wash card/cash receipts (auto-paid), and fleet net-15 invoices.

entities.name: Payment
entities.description: A processed payment - one-off card/cash/ACH at checkout, or a recurring membership charge.

entities.name: Journal Entry
entities.description: Double-entry ledger header, auto-posted from workflow events.

entities.name: Journal Line
entities.description: One debit or credit line of a JournalEntry.

entities.name: Support Ticket
entities.description: A customer complaint or question - damage claims, billing disputes, membership questions.

entities.name: Social Post
entities.description: A content-calendar entry for the social suite.

roles.name: Site Manager
roles.description: Runs daily operations for the location.

roles.name: Bay Attendant
roles.description: Greets vehicles, loads the tunnel, directs queue.

roles.name: Wash Technician
roles.description: Operates tunnel controls and express-lane wash quality.

roles.name: Detail Technician
roles.description: Hand-wax and interior detailing in the detail bays.

roles.name: Fleet Account Manager
roles.description: Part-time role handling the small commercial/fleet segment.

workflows.name: Wash a Vehicle (primary lifecycle)
workflows.trigger: Vehicle arrives on site (walk-in) or an appointment's scheduled time is reached

steps.action: Log vehicle, select package, verify membership plate or take payment method
steps.onFailure: If plate lookup fails, attendant manually searches by phone/name; if no match, treats as new walk-in

steps.action: Assign next open bay/technician balancing queue length and package-to-lane fit (detail packages only to detail bays)
steps.onFailure: If no bay opens within 10 minutes, escalate to site-manager to consider opening the self-serve overflow area

steps.action: Load vehicle into tunnel or begin detail-bay service
steps.onFailure: Cycle stall or equipment fault triggers bay-down-alert automation and reroutes queued vehicles

steps.action: Visual QC against the package's checklist (streaks, missed spots, interior if included)
steps.onFailure: qc-failed-rework transition sends vehicle back through InWash at no extra charge

steps.action: Confirm membership verification or collect payment
steps.onFailure: Card decline routes to a manual retry or cash fallback before marking Completed

steps.action: Send ready-for-pickup notification if the customer opted into WhatsApp/SMS
steps.onFailure: Silently skip if no opt-in on file - not a hard failure

workflows.name: Enroll in a Membership Plan
workflows.trigger: Customer signs up for an unlimited plan (at kiosk, via WhatsApp, or online)

steps.action: Capture vehicle plate and store a payment method token
steps.onFailure: Decline card entry blocks activation until a valid method is provided

steps.action: Create MembershipSubscription in Active state, set billing day
steps.onFailure: n/a

steps.action: Send welcome message with plan terms and how plate verification works at the tunnel entry
steps.onFailure: Log and retry once if send fails

workflows.name: Cancellation / Rework / Refund
workflows.trigger: Customer requests a cancellation before wash starts, or disputes wash quality after checkout

steps.action: Cancel WashOrder if still Queued or BayAssigned, no charge
steps.onFailure: n/a

steps.action: Offer a free rework wash within the guardrail; open a Ticket for anything beyond a rework (damage claim, refund request)
steps.onFailure: Escalate to site-manager if customer is unsatisfied with the offered rework

steps.action: Approve and process any refund over the agent's autonomous threshold
steps.onFailure: If unactioned, the Ticket's SLA-breach reminder escalates further before the SLA is actually missed

workflows.name: Staff Onboarding
workflows.trigger: A new hire's start date arrives

steps.action: Create Employee record, assign role and certifications needed
steps.onFailure: n/a

steps.action: Create first Shift paired with a senior technician for training
steps.onFailure: n/a

steps.action: Assign RBAC role/permissions per 10-security-rbac-abac.md
steps.onFailure: n/a

workflows.name: Inventory Reorder
workflows.trigger: Supply stock crosses reorderThreshold, or the nightly forecast run

steps.action: Project consumption from rolling wash-volume and package mix, draft a PurchaseOrder
steps.onFailure: n/a

steps.action: Approve PO above the agent's autonomous spend threshold
steps.onFailure: PO stays in Draft until approved or edited

steps.action: Receive shipment, update Stock, mark PO Received
steps.onFailure: Partial shipment sets PurchaseOrder to PartiallyReceived

workflows.name: Escalation / Complaint Handling
workflows.trigger: A negative review, a damage claim, or a WhatsApp message with negative sentiment

steps.action: Classify sentiment/category and open a Ticket for anything beyond a simple thank-you-worthy positive mention
steps.onFailure: n/a

steps.action: Review and respond to the customer directly for damage claims and negative reviews
steps.onFailure: SLA breach reminder fires if untouched past the target

workflows.name: Predictive Maintenance
workflows.trigger: IoT telemetry on a monitored Asset drifts outside its normal operating range

steps.action: Compare live telemetry trend to the asset's learned normal range, distinguish slow drift from a sudden spike
steps.onFailure: n/a

steps.action: Auto-create a MaintenanceOrder, pull parts from Stock or generate a PurchaseOrder if short
steps.onFailure: n/a

steps.action: Confirm taking the asset offline during business hours (skipped if already failed/unsafe)
steps.onFailure: n/a

steps.action: Perform the repair, log partsUsed, mark MaintenanceOrder Completed
steps.onFailure: If the repair doesn't resolve the flagged fault, MaintenanceOrder reopens to Scheduled with an escalation note; a second failed attempt notifies site-manager directly

kpis.name: Cars Washed per Day
kpis.formula: count(WashOrder where status = Completed, grouped by day)

kpis.name: Bay Utilization Rate
kpis.formula: sum(WashOrder.washCompletedAt - washStartedAt) / (operational hours x bay count)

kpis.name: Membership Penetration Rate
kpis.formula: count(WashOrder where paymentMethod = membership) / count(WashOrder), trailing 30 days

kpis.name: Blended Revenue per Vehicle
kpis.formula: sum(WashOrder.price) / count(WashOrder) -- for membership washes, price is the plan's amortized per-visit value, see analytics.md

kpis.name: Net Membership Growth
kpis.formula: count(MembershipSubscription: Active entries this month) - count(Cancelled this month)

kpis.name: Chemical Cost per Wash
kpis.formula: sum(Supply.costPerUnit x consumption) / count(WashOrder), trailing 30 days

kpis.name: Equipment Uptime Rate
kpis.formula: 1 - (sum(Asset downtime hours) / (Asset count x operational hours)), trailing 30 days

kpis.name: Average Review Rating
kpis.formula: avg(external review rating) across Google/Yelp, trailing 90 days

kpis.name: Technician Utilization
kpis.formula: sum(active wash-cycle minutes assigned) / sum(Shift scheduled minutes) per technician

aiAgents.name: Ops Orchestrator
aiAgents.purpose: Holds the day's operating picture across the wash floor (queue depth, bay status, staffing, open escalations) and routes work to the right specialist agent rather than each agent polling blind.
guardrails: Never overrides a specialist agent's guardrail (e.g. cannot approve a refund on membership-billing-agent's behalf) - routing only, no independent transactional authority.

aiAgents.name: Strategy Advisor
aiAgents.purpose: Answers open-ended owner questions ("should we add a 5th tunnel bay", "why did membership churn spike in July", "is the premium tier worth the price gap") with a structured, traceable recommendation rather than a bare opinion.
aiAgents.memory: Remembers prior recommendations and their stated confidence for 12 months, so it flags rather than silently contradicts an earlier stance.
triggers: Owner asks a question via the Executive View or WhatsApp
A health-score or anomaly alert crosses a severity threshold worth investigating
guardrails: Never commits to a lease, hire, price change, or equipment purchase - output is always a recommendation with confidence and a suggested cheap experiment (e.g. 'trial the price increase on new sign-ups only for 30 days before repricing existing members'), routed to owner.

aiAgents.name: System Health Agent
aiAgents.purpose: Watches the AI workforce's own operating data (escalation rates, automation failure rates, anomaly-rule firing frequency, message-stacking) and produces a weekly health report with concrete threshold fixes - it never touches customers or transactional entities.
triggers: Weekly schedule, Monday 6am before the site opens
guardrails: Recommends threshold/config changes only - never self-modifies another agent's guardrails; all changes route through escalatesTo for a human decision.

aiAgents.name: Queue Dispatch Agent
aiAgents.purpose: Assigns each queued vehicle to the next appropriate open bay (respecting tunnel-vs-detail-bay package fit) and technician, and predicts wait time so the concierge can tell a customer a real number.
triggers: Asset status change on a bay's equipment
guardrails: Never reprioritizes a fleet vehicle ahead of an earlier-queued walk-in without an explicit fleet SLA rule on file.
Escalates to site-manager if predicted wait exceeds 25 minutes for 3 consecutive vehicles (open self-serve overflow or call in an extra bay-attendant).

aiAgents.name: Wash Concierge
aiAgents.purpose: Handles membership sign-up, order-status lookup ("where's my car"), rebooking a detail appointment, and FAQ (guarantee/rework policy, hours, pricing) over WhatsApp.
triggers: WashOrder status change for an opted-in customer
guardrails: Can offer a free rework wash at $0 cost without approval; any cash refund request over $15 is escalated to site-manager, never processed autonomously.
Escalates to site-manager immediately on negative sentiment or a damage-claim mention, or below 70% confidence on any request outside FAQ/booking/status.
aiAgents.memory: Per-customer conversation history retained 90 days so a repeat question isn't answered from scratch.

aiAgents.name: Membership Billing Agent
aiAgents.purpose: Runs the monthly membership billing cycle, retries failed charges, and manages the past-due/suspension/pause lifecycle on MembershipSubscription.
guardrails: Never cancels a membership before 3 failed retry attempts spread over 7 days.
Never charges a stored payment method without documented consent on file at signup.
Suspension (not cancellation) is the automatic outcome of unresolved past-due status - cancellation after 30 days suspended is a scheduled transition, not an agent decision each time.

aiAgents.name: Inventory Forecaster
aiAgents.purpose: Predicts chemical/consumable usage (soap, wax, tire shine, microfiber towels, reclaim filter media) from rolling wash volume and package mix, flags reorder points, and drafts purchase orders.
guardrails: Auto-approves and sends POs under $150; anything above requires site-manager sign-off before the PO leaves Draft.

aiAgents.name: Predictive Maintenance Agent
aiAgents.purpose: Watches IoT telemetry (vibration, motor current draw, temperature, water flow/turbidity, blower RPM, compressor pressure) on the tunnel conveyor motor, water reclaim system, boiler, air compressor, and dryer blowers, distinguishes slow bearing/filter drift from a sudden fault spike, and auto-opens a MaintenanceOrder before hard failure.
triggers: Continuous telemetry stream (evaluated every 60 seconds against each asset's learned normal range)
guardrails: Can create/schedule a MaintenanceOrder and request parts autonomously.

Taking equipment offline during business hours requires site-manager confirmation unless the asset has already failed or is unsafe to keep running (e.g. boiler over-temperature), in which case it takes the asset offline immediately and notifies site-manager.

aiAgents.name: Quality Anomaly Detector
aiAgents.purpose: Flags a wash cycle whose duration is statistically too fast (a likely skipped step) or too slow (a likely jam) compared to that package's normal cycle time, routing it to a human QC glance before checkout.
guardrails: Never blocks checkout on its own - flags for a human wash-technician glance only; qcResult is always set by a person, not by this agent.

aiAgents.name: Review Response Agent
aiAgents.purpose: Monitors Google Business Profile and social mentions, auto-thanks simple positive reviews with a loyalty-point offer, and opens a Ticket + immediate site-manager alert for anything negative or mentioning damage.
guardrails: Never auto-responds to a review below 4 stars or one mentioning damage/injury/billing - always escalated to site-manager, never auto-replied.

aiAgents.name: Fleet Lead Scorer
aiAgents.purpose: Scores an inbound commercial/fleet inquiry (vehicle count requested, business-hours contact pattern, invoicing-terms request) and creates a follow-up notification for the fleet-account-manager rather than a full sales pipeline - most fleet interest is a handful of local businesses, not a sales org.
triggers: Customer.isFleetAccount flagged true, or a WhatsApp/phone inquiry mentions multiple vehicles
guardrails: Never commits to custom fleet pricing - always a human-quoted follow-up.

aiAgents.name: Phone Line Agent
aiAgents.purpose: Answers and triages inbound calls (hours, membership pricing, fleet inquiries), transcribes and summarizes the call onto the relevant Customer/Ticket record, and can place outbound calls for a high-value fleet callback or an overdue-payment call escalated from membership-billing-agent.
triggers: Outbound-call handoff from membership-billing-agent or fleet-lead-scorer
guardrails: Never collects or reads back full payment card details over the phone - directs the caller to the kiosk, WhatsApp payment link, or a human for anything requiring card entry.
Escalates anything beyond hours/pricing/FAQ to a human role immediately, same threshold as wash-concierge.

automations.condition: customer.whatsappOptIn == true && paymentMethod != 'membership' && no other message sent to this customer today

useCases: Membership sign-up and billing lifecycle messaging
Order status lookup ("where's my car") via the concierge
flows: book-detail-appointment -> enroll/booking workflow -> handoff to cashier if the customer wants to pay by an unsupported method
membership-signup -> enroll-membership workflow -> handoff to cashier only if plate lookup conflicts with an existing subscription
wash-status-lookup -> read-only WashOrder query, no handoff needed
human-handoff -> triggered by low confidence or negative sentiment, routes to site-manager's inbox
whatsapp.consentEntity: Customer.whatsappOptIn (transactional messaging implied by using the service; Customer.marketingConsent required separately for MARKETING-category sends)

platforms: Instagram - before/after wash and detail shots, high-visual local business
TikTok - satisfying tunnel-wash and foam-cannon short-form video
Google Business Profile - review generation is disproportionately valuable for a location-based business
Facebook - local community groups, event/seasonal promo reach for an older demographic than Instagram/TikTok
contentPillars: membership value ('what unlimited actually saves you')
seasonal promos (pollen season, post-storm, holiday gift memberships)
socialMedia.postingCadence: Instagram 4x/week, TikTok 3x/week, Facebook 2x/week, Google Business Profile posts weekly + review responses daily

segments: Active Pay-Per-Wash (wash in last 30d, no membership)
At-Risk Member (2+ missed expected visits or a recent PastDue)
At-Risk Pay-Per-Wash (no wash in 45-90d, previously 3+ visits)
Lapsed (>90d no wash, no active membership)
funnels: Awareness (social/Google Business Profile) -> First Wash (walk-in or promo code) -> Membership Conversion -> Retained Member -> Advocate (referral)

campaigns.note: see 04-growth/marketing.md for the full table - segment/channel/trigger/offer

loyalty.type: points-per-dollar for pay-per-wash customers, redeemable for a free upgrade tier or a free wash; membership itself is the primary retention mechanic for repeat visitors

referral.type: referral code on Customer, referred customer gets 50% off first wash, referrer gets a free wash credited on the referred customer's first completed WashOrder

abTests.hypothesis: Showing the premium tier first makes the basic tier feel like the 'value' choice, raising basic sign-up rate
abTests.metric: membership sign-up conversion rate at kiosk

steps: Day 3: membership value comparison (savings after 3 washes/mo)
Day 10: membership sign-up offer with a limited-time discount

dripSequences.trigger: MembershipSubscription enters PastDue or 2 missed expected visits in a cycle
steps: Day 4: escalate to email with a pause-instead-of-cancel offer
Day 8: phone-line-agent outbound callback offer if still unresolved

abacPolicies: A site-manager can only approve a refund or PO within their own site's scope - moot at single-location scale but stated for when the business expands.

A support agent (human or wash-concierge) can view Customer.paymentMethodToken only in masked/last-4 form, and only while handling an active WashOrder or Ticket for that customer, never for general browsing.
Marketing campaigns (marketing.campaigns, marketing.dripSequences, WhatsApp MARKETING-category templates) can only target customers where Customer.marketingConsent == true.
Only site-manager or owner can approve a MaintenanceOrder that takes a bay offline during posted operating hours, unless the triggering Asset is already status = down or unsafe.
complianceNotes: PCI-DSS scope minimization: payment card data is never stored directly - Customer.paymentMethodToken and Payment.processorTxnId are tokens from the Stripe integration, not raw card numbers.

Water discharge/reclaim system operation may be subject to local wastewater/environmental permitting - track the water-reclaim-ro-system Asset's compliance-relevant readings (turbidity, discharge volume) as part of its maintenance log for inspection readiness.

Employee compensation and tax-ID fields (Employee.hourlyRate, any government ID collected at hire) are piiOrSensitive and restricted to site-manager/owner - a co-worker never sees another employee's pay rate.
No health, food-safety, or childcare-specific compliance regime applies to this business category.

models: demand-forecast: predicts daily/hourly wash volume from historical WashOrder counts, day-of-week seasonality, and a weather-api rain/pollen overlay
bay-throughput-queue-simulator: given bay count, avg cycle time per package tier, and technician staffing, computes expected vehicles/hour capacity and queue wait
staffing-capacity-simulator: staff-hours needed vs. scheduled Shift hours, tied to the demand forecast and package mix
cash-flow-forecast: membership MRR (recurring) plus forecasted pay-per-wash revenue against payroll, chemical costs, utilities, and equipment financing
membership-economics-simulator: wash-through rate, plan LTV, CAC, and the breakeven visit count where an unlimited member becomes unprofitable
pricing-scenario-simulator: revenue/margin impact of a membership price change or a new package tier
downtime-cost-simulator: lost throughput x average ticket value for an Asset going down, by bay type and time of day

reports.name: Average Order Value by Vehicle Type

anomalyRules: avg-wait-time-minutes moves more than 2 standard deviations above its trailing 4-week baseline for the same hour-of-day/day-of-week
membership cancellation count in a week exceeds 2x the trailing 8-week average
chemical-cost-per-wash rises more than 15% week-over-week with no corresponding package-mix shift
an Asset's telemetry-flagged anomaly count doubles week-over-week (possible sensor fault or genuine accelerating wear)

contributes: telemetry trend history and raw signal detail beyond the live read
externalSources.freshness: streamed near-real-time, ingestion-store batch every 5 minutes

contributes: website/landing-page traffic and ad click-throughs to the membership signup page
externalSources.freshness: synced nightly, up to 24h behind native data

crossSourceAnalyses.answers: true net margin per membership tier after processing fees and the amortized chemical/water/labor cost per visit at the plan's actual wash-through rate - not just sticker MRR
how much of a slow day is explained by weather vs. an actual demand/marketing problem, so a rainy Tuesday doesn't get misread as a marketing failure
for each predictive-maintenance catch, how much downtime (and revenue) was avoided vs. if the same fault had run to hard failure, justifying the sensor investment in dollars
true cost to acquire a paying member across ad spend and processing fees per signup, vs. the ad platform's own self-reported conversion count

taxRules.rate: per local car-wash service tax rate
taxRules.appliesTo: WashOrder line items where taxable per local rule

closeChecklist: Reconcile Stripe payout bank feed against Payment records
Post accrued supplier invoices for chemicals received but not yet billed
Post the month's depreciation on Asset equipment
Review fleet AR aging and flag anything past 45 days for fleet-account-manager follow-up
Reconcile Loyalty Points Payable against points issued/redeemed this period
Lock the period from further edits

leadScoring: Customer.fleetLeadScore incorporates: vehicle count requested (3+ vehicles = high), inquiry mentions recurring/scheduled washing, requests net-15 invoicing terms

slaPolicies.firstResponse: 1h (usually resolved by wash-concierge without a human)

inventory.reorderPolicy: Reorder to a 30-day par level whenever on-hand drops below a 7-day average-consumption supply, computed from trailing wash volume by package mix.

suppliers.name: Regional Car Wash Chemical Supply Co.

compensationModel: hourly wage plus a per-detail-job commission for detail-technician (10% of PackagePricing.price on completed detail-bay WashOrders)
hourly plus a small per-signed-fleet-account bonus for fleet-account-manager
leavePolicies: 10 PTO days/year, accrued monthly, for full-time staff (30+ scheduled hours/week average)
hr.performanceReviewCadence: quarterly informal check-in, formal annual review - single-location scale doesn't warrant more formal cadence than that

replace reclaim filter media, check turbidity output
drain moisture trap, check belt tension
